origin: The planning dispose had no decline at all — `process-review-findings.md` said in terms that nothing is declined there — so a reviewer that prescribed mechanism the specification never decided had a 100% acceptance rate, and twelve cycles of Portal's plan review wrote a terminal escape parser into a task's Do one defect at a time. The dispose's decline is the builder's, and under the provenance rule it is the ordinary case rather than the exception: a mechanism the specification never decided — whatever the staged Proposal makes of it — or a boundary, byte, ordering or format detail any competent implementer settles the same way, refused before anything renders. This walks it against a real gap in the same file, so the decline has to be a judgement and not a filter on the whole tracking file: one finding never reaches the user, the other is presented and approved, and the Observations line under them is never walked either.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments plan, authored and graphed last sitting; offered the resume choice they pick it up where it left off, and when asked they confirm the phase structure and the task graph still hold. They know the specification cold and treat what it decides as decided. The one finding put to them is what a shopper whose card is declined is shown — a call the specification already made and the intent task never carried — and they approve it as it stands, since it is only the record being written down where the builder will read it. They want their own eyes on anything the review proposes: offered a way to hand the rest over automatically at any point, they would decline and keep approving one at a time. Asked whether to run the review round again they would rather move on — they have a release to get out and the plan says what the product does. At the conclusion they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely and never reopen what they have settled.

stubs.plan-graph-applied: when the prose invokes the dependency-grapher agent — apply the graph to the task files as the stub's description states (already-present values reapply unchanged), then return the content below as the agent's summary
stubs.plan-review-clean: when the prose invokes the planning traceability review agent via the Task tool for review cycle 1 — return the content below and write no file
stubs.plan-integrity-a-builders-call-and-a-rea: when the prose invokes the planning integrity review agent via the Task tool for review cycle 1 — write the tracking file and return the status block as the stub describes
